name: db-mysql
title: Database: MySQL
description: MySQL 8 via mysql2. Adds DATABASE_URL env, pool singleton, docker-compose service.

patches.content:
mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    environment:
      MYSQL_USER: user
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: <%= packageName %>
      MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD: 'yes'
    ports:
      - '3306:3306'
    volumes:
      - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
